object_detection.explanation: Detection requires usable object annotations; syntax, label presence and deployment requirements receive priority.

classification.explanation: Classification prioritizes usable class labels and explicitly requested class distribution; boxes are inapplicable.

regression.explanation: Regression prioritizes valid target/signal records and integrity; class and box criteria are inapplicable.

anomaly_detection.explanation: Anomaly analysis prioritizes observed signal integrity and operational coverage; anomaly-label semantics need an independent audit.

telemetry.explanation: Telemetry prioritizes signal, schema and operational evidence; image sharpness and boxes are inapplicable.

tracking.explanation: Tracking needs annotations and temporal independence; unsupported identity/continuity evidence remains unassessed.

default.explanation: No explicit scenario policy selected; retain the documented task defaults.

airport_drone_detection.explanation: Opt-in engineering sensitivity policy: prioritize object annotation integrity and confirmed airport operating conditions. Does not establish small-drone visibility or distractor coverage.

nighttime_detection.explanation: Opt-in engineering sensitivity policy: prioritize visual-signal criteria and confirmed nighttime evidence. Brightness alone does not establish nighttime coverage.
